fallback.text: The gain of an RC low-pass filter with R = 1.6 kΩ and C = 100 nF: flat (0 dB) at low frequencies, 3 dB down at the cutoff frequency fc = 1/(2πRC) ≈ 1 kHz, then falling by 20 dB for every tenfold rise in frequency. A larger R or C moves fc down; the time constant τ = RC is how long the output takes to reach 63 % of a step.
